name: Sales by category
query:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN ig.parent_item_group = 'Services' OR ig.name = 'Services' THEN 'Servicio (Exento)' ELSE 'Producto (Gravado)' END AS "Categoria:Data:200",
    SUM(sii.amount) AS "Total Vendido:Currency:150"
FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = sii.parent
JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.item_code = sii.item_code
JOIN `tabItem Group` ig ON ig.name = i.item_group
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
GROUP BY CASE WHEN ig.parent_item_group = 'Services' OR ig.name = 'Services' THEN 'Servicio (Exento)' ELSE 'Producto (Gravado)' END

name: Profit and cost
query:
SELECT
    sii.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item:150",
    sii.item_name AS "Nombre:Data:200",
    SUM(sii.qty) AS "Cantidad Vendida:Float:120",
    SUM(sii.amount) AS "Total Vendido:Currency:150",
    b.valuation_rate AS "Costo Promedio Ponderado:Currency:180",
    SUM(sii.amount) - SUM(sii.qty) * b.valuation_rate AS "Ganancia:Currency:150"
FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = sii.parent
JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.item_code = sii.item_code
JOIN `tabItem Group` ig ON ig.name = i.item_group
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT item_code, AVG(valuation_rate) AS valuation_rate
    FROM `tabBin`
    WHERE actual_qty > 0
    GROUP BY item_code
) b ON b.item_code = sii.item_code
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
  AND ig.parent_item_group != 'Services'
  AND ig.name != 'Services'
GROUP BY sii.item_code, sii.item_name, b.valuation_rate
ORDER BY 6 DESC
